claims.claim: R1-1: With six rows, the old results layout overflowed at 844×390: the title was clipped at the top and RETRY / NEXT RACE were pushed below the bottom edge.
claims.evidence: The pre-fix layout isn't in the inputs. The diff does make every player-started race six cars (PLAYER_CAR_COUNT = 6 on RACE/RETRY/RESTART/NEXT), so the results table really does go from 2 rows to 6. The y-coordinates the review gives (-6.9 / 435.9) can't be checked here.

claims.claim: R1-1 fix: the stripe is now a direct child of the screen. The left column holds label, title, roundel and best-lap chip. The right column (ui-results__side) holds the table with the actions under it.
claims.evidence: src/ui/results-screen.ts hunk: stripes() is a top-level child; the first ui-results__column holds [label, trackName, roundel, best panel]; 'ui-results__column ui-results__side' holds rows plus ui-results__actions.

claims.claim: R1-1 fix CSS: the stripe is an absolute, edge-to-edge 4:2:1 band of height s3; the side column is right-aligned with gap s4; row gap goes from s2 to s1; rows use type-button-size; tokens only.
claims.evidence: results.css: .ui-results > .ui-stripes {position:absolute; top/left/right:0}; .ui-stripe flex 1, red flex 4, mustard flex 2, height var(--space-s3); .ui-results__side align-items:flex-end, gap var(--space-s4); rows gap s2→s1; .ui-results__row.ui-value font-size var(--type-button-size). Every value is a var() token.

claims.claim: R1-1: six rows plus the buttons now fit within 844×390.
claims.evidence: screenshots/844x390/stage/results--podium.png shows the stripe, the title, all 6 rows, RETRY and NEXT RACE all inside the frame. (results--long-list with 8 rows still overflows, but that is a stage fixture, not a real race.)

claims.claim: R1-1: the new test tests/ui/results-fit-phone.test.ts renders results--podium at 844×390 in Chromium and checks that stripes, title, rows and both buttons are inside the viewport.
claims.evidence: The test file is in the diff: it does a vite build of harness/screens, calls renderStage(ctx, origin, 'results--podium') with PHONE 844×390, collects .ui-stripes, h2, [role=row] and the retry/next buttons, then asserts none are out of bounds.

claims.claim: R1-1: no behaviour, roles or DOM hooks used by tests changed.
claims.evidence: The results-screen.ts change only moves elements between containers. role='table' and aria-label='Results', the class names and the button handlers (opts.onRaceAgain, next) are unchanged.

claims.claim: R2-2 fix: `menuTrack = track;` was moved below raceDrivers/createWorld/carViews, so a rejected carCount no longer changes the menu track.
claims.evidence: game.ts startRace: raceDrivers(options.carCount ?? DEFAULT_CAR_COUNT), then createWorld, then carViews, then `menuTrack = track;` just before `race = {`.

claims.claim: R2-2: raceDrivers throws for carCount 7, 0 or 2.5.
claims.evidence: src/content/drivers.ts isn't in the diff, so the throw behaviour can't be seen. The new test only exercises carCount 7, via expect(...).toThrow().

claims.claim: R2-2: the new test tests/game/start-race-invalid-count.test.ts checks that trackId is unchanged and mode stays 'menu'.
claims.evidence: The test asserts game.state().trackId toBe(before) and game.state().mode toBe('menu'). It also carries a stray playerLivery mock.

claims.claim: R3-1 fix: the duplicated playerInputs helpers were replaced by tests/game/helpers.ts twinPlayerInputs(trackId, seed, carCount, maxTicks), built on botsFor from tests/sim/helpers.ts, and both six-car test files now use it.
claims.evidence: tests/game/helpers.ts imports botsFor from '../sim/helpers.ts' and exports twinPlayerInputs. six-car-grid.test.ts calls it with TEN_MINUTES (60*60*10) and six-car-race.test.ts calls it with FIVE_MINUTES. Neither file has createBot or a local loop.

claims.claim: R3-1: botsFor already exists at tests/sim/helpers.ts:62.
claims.evidence: The diff imports it from tests/sim/helpers.ts and that file isn't changed, so it must exist. The line number can't be checked.

claims.claim: pnpm typecheck passes and pnpm test passes with 600 tests (77 files).
claims.evidence: gates.md G1: typecheck and build ok, 600/600 tests passed (main 588). The file count isn't shown.

claims.claim: All three fixes were kept because the gates pass with them.
claims.evidence: gates.md overall PASS on branch ea713b8ba790 (the R3-1 fix commit): G1, G2, G3 and G8 all pass.

structured_output.summary: review.md lists three verified fixes. All three match the diff. R1-1 reworks the results layout: the stripe becomes a full-width top band, the table and buttons move to a right column, and rows get a tighter gap and smaller type, all through tokens. The 844×390 podium screenshot shows six rows and both buttons fitting. R2-2 moves the menuTrack assignment after raceDrivers/createWorld and adds a regression test. R3-1 merges the two duplicated playerInputs helpers into tests/game/helpers.ts on top of the existing botsFor. Test counts match gates.md (600/600). I can't confirm everything: raceDrivers' throw behaviour, the botsFor line number and the pre-fix pixel positions aren't in the inputs. The review is also silent on two things my blind scores flagged: the 8-row long-list stage still overflows, and src/sim/world.ts adds curved grid slots beyond the expected files. No new agent rules and no planted instructions found.
